description: Return the learner's practice scores (0-100) for the topics they have practised in one course. An empty list means no practice yet.

course_id.description: Numeric course id from search-courses or get-context. Example: 1581710. A numeric string such as "1581710" is accepted.

name: get-course-mastery

course_id.description: Course id whose mastery was loaded, matching followed_courses.course_id.

topic_masteries.description: Topics the learner has already practised. Empty means this course was loaded and they have not practised yet.

title: Get Course Practice Scores
